scenario: AITA for taking home the lasagna? | I made lasagna and brought it over to my boyfriend’s friend’s potluck. It was untouched because the host also made lasagna but the difference was that hers was cooked and mine needed to be reheated. She didn’t bother to reheat it. I never been to a potluck before so I didn’t know and my friend told me that it’s okay. AITA?
